tasks.short: Transpose the score, then judge the key.

steps.what: Transpose the stored score by the interval the musician requested.
Decide whether the transposed music fits the individual style or purpose.
File the accepted transposition to the alternate key.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shifts every note of a score it already holds by the interval the musician named, into the alternate key. The musician decides whether that key fits the individual style or the purpose. Only the accepted transposition is filed, and only that version. A score with no source key, or a request with no target key, is not transposed. The arithmetic does not judge the voice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Transposition was done by hand on a copy, and a key that did not fit the voice was discovered in rehearsal.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored score can be shifted by a named interval. Whether the key fits is still the musician's decision.
tasks.still_hard: A correct interval can still sit badly for a voice or a style, and the arithmetic cannot hear that.
tasks.human_edge: The musician accepts or refuses the key. The shift only moves the notes that were already in the score.
tasks.altitude: The musician still decides the key. Filing happens only for the transposition the musician has accepted, and a missing key stops the shift.

reach.task: Fit a line to a singer after the words have been moved.
reach.learn: Moving the line is not knowing it fits.

evidence.claim: Shifting every note of a stored score by a requested interval is arithmetic on the notation. It does not decide whether the key fits a voice, a style, or a purpose.
Audio-to-score transcription is a different task and is not used here. The source is a score the company already holds.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.

Fields: The score id, the source key already on the score, and the target key the musician named. A missing key stops the shift. The style and the purpose are not fields the arithmetic fills. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the notation already in the document store before sending the score to a new tool.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the musician.
unknowns: Whether every held score has a reliable source key.
research_questions: Who may name the target key, the musician or the conductor?

already_counted.description: Judging whether the transposed key fits stays with the musician.

approvals.approved_version: score version and the target key it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still decides whether the new key fits the style or the purpose, and still accepts the version that is filed. Only the interval shift of a score already held is removed. A missing source or target key saves nothing, and no recording is transcribed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Memorize the selection or follow the page.

steps.what: Show the printed musical notation or the customer instruction already written.
Memorize musical selections and routines, or sing following the printed text.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the printed musical notation, the printed text, or the customer instruction if one is already written. The musician memorizes the selection and the routine, or sings following that page. The page does not memorize the music. A selection with nothing written leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notation, lyrics, and the customer's instruction arrived as three papers.
tasks.enabler_now: A page already written can be shown. Memorizing it, or singing from it, stays with the musician.
tasks.still_hard: A routine is memorized by repetition, not by opening the file.
tasks.human_edge: The musician memorizes or sings from the page. The screen only shows what was already written.
tasks.altitude: Memory work stays with the musician. The printed notation or the customer instruction is shown and is not a substitute for learning it.

reach.task: Learn a side from the printed text.
reach.learn: Opening the side is not knowing it.

evidence.claim: Showing notation or an instruction already written is a lookup. It does not memorize the selection or the routine.
The customer instruction is followed by the musician. It is not rewritten by the screen.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.
Fields: The selection id and the notation or instruction only if already written. Nothing is drafted. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the page from the document store.
unknowns: Whether customer instructions are allowed to override the printed notation.
research_questions: Who writes the customer instruction before the musician sees it?

already_counted.description: Memorizing or singing from the page stays with the musician.

incremental.description: Remove instructions for selections that were dropped.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still memorizes the selection or sings from the printed page. Only showing notation or an instruction already written is removed. A selection with nothing written saves nothing.

tasks.short: Watch the conductor for the cue.

steps.what: Show the cue mark already written in the vocal score.
Observe choral leaders or prompters for cues or directions in the vocal presentation.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows a cue mark if one is already written in the vocal score. The musician watches the choral leader or the prompter and takes the cue or the direction in the presentation. The mark does not give the cue. A score with no mark leaves the screen blank, and the musician still watches the leader.
tasks.previous_blocker: The cue was a look from the leader, and a pencil mark in the score was easy to miss under lights.
tasks.enabler_now: A written cue mark can be shown. Watching the leader or the prompter stays in the room.
tasks.still_hard: A cue is a person's gesture in time, and a mark on the page is not that gesture.
tasks.human_edge: The musician watches the leader and takes the cue. The mark is only a reminder already written.
tasks.altitude: The cue stays a look to the leader or the prompter. A mark already in the score is visible and does not replace the watch.

reach.task: Take a cue from another actor, not from a pencil mark.
reach.learn: The mark is not the cue.

evidence.claim: A cue mark already in the score is a reminder. It does not observe the leader or the prompter.
The direction in the presentation is given by a person. The mark cannot give it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.
Fields: The score id and the cue mark only if it is already written. The mark is not inferred from the notation. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the score from the document store.
unknowns: Whether this group uses a conductor, a prompter, or both.
research_questions: Who writes the cue mark into the score?

already_counted.description: Watching the leader and taking the cue stay with the musician.

incremental.description: Clear cue marks when the score edition changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still watches the choral leader or the prompter and still takes the cue. Only showing a cue mark already written in the score is removed. A score with no mark saves nothing of the watch.

tasks.short: Work the date with the manager.

steps.what: Show the date, the fee, and the place already on the booking.
Collaborate with the manager or agent on the administrative details and the work.
Accept or refuse the date. Do not send the contract.

tasks.design: The {CALENDAR} shows the date, the fee, and the place if they are already on the booking. The musician collaborates with the manager or agent on those administrative details and on the work itself. The musician accepts or refuses the date. The manager negotiates and sends any contract, and that sending is not this task. A booking with no date is not shown. The screen does not accept the date.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dates and fees were in mail, and the musician accepted a date without the fee in view.
tasks.enabler_now: A booking already written can be shown during the conversation. Accepting the date stays with the musician, and the contract stays with the manager.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the work is worth the date is a conversation, not a field on the booking.
tasks.human_edge: The musician talks with the manager and accepts or refuses the date. The booking does not decide.
tasks.altitude: The conversation with the manager stays with the musician. A contract is not sent from this task, and a date is accepted only by the musician.

reach.task: Accept a date with an agent after seeing the terms.
reach.learn: The terms on screen are not the acceptance.

evidence.claim: Showing a date, a fee, and a place already on a booking is a lookup. It does not negotiate, and it does not accept the work.
A contract filled from a booking would be the manager's sending. This task does not send it. The musician only accepts or refuses the date.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.

Fields: The booking id and the date, fee, and place only if already stored. Missing terms stop the screen. The musician's acceptance is spoken, not filed as a contract. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the booking from the calendar the company already uses.
The manager's contract work is outside this task and is not counted as the musician's time.
unknowns: Whether the manager is an employee or an external agent.
research_questions: Which terms must be on the booking before the musician will discuss the date?

already_counted.description: The conversation and the acceptance or refusal stay with the musician.

incremental.description: Clear bookings the musician has refused.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still collaborates with the manager and still accepts or refuses the date. Only showing terms already on the booking is removed. No contract is sent. A booking with no date saves nothing.

role.altitude: The musician still decides whether a key fits, still memorizes, and still watches the conductor. A stored score can be shifted by a requested interval, and that arithmetic is not the musical decision. The musician still accepts a date with the manager.
reach: Poets, lyricists and creative writers fit words to a purpose, and this job learns a shifted key is not yet a fit.
Actors take a cue from a person, and this job learns a pencil mark is not the cue.
skills_to_grow: Check a transposed score against the voice and the purpose before it is filed.
Memorize the selection, or sing from the printed notation.
Accept or refuse a date with the manager. Do not send the contract.
role.ambitious_version: Transposition of a stored score is arithmetic and is filed only after the musician accepts it. Memory, cues, and the conversation with the manager stay with the musician.
